213:     Calendar calendar = new GregorianCalendar(tz, isoLocale);
214:     calendar.setTime(date);
215: 
216:     int capacity = "yyyy-MM-ddThh:mm:ss".length();
217:     capacity += millis ? ".sss".length() : 0;
218:     capacity += tz.getRawOffset() == isoTimeZone.getRawOffset() && tz.getRawOffset() == 0
219:         ? "Z".length() : "+hh:mm".length();

221: 
222:     padIsoInt(formatted, calendar.get(Calendar.YEAR), "yyyy".length());
223:     formatted.append('-');
224:     padIsoInt(formatted, calendar.get(Calendar.MONTH) + 1, "MM".length());
225:     formatted.append('-');
226:     padIsoInt(formatted, calendar.get(Calendar.DAY_OF_MONTH), "dd".length());
227:     formatted.append('T');
228:     padIsoInt(formatted, calendar.get(Calendar.HOUR_OF_DAY), "hh".length());
229:     formatted.append(':');
230:     padIsoInt(formatted, calendar.get(Calendar.MINUTE), "mm".length());
231:     formatted.append(':');
232:     padIsoInt(formatted, calendar.get(Calendar.SECOND), "ss".length());
233:     if (millis) {
234:       formatted.append('.');
235:       padIsoInt(formatted, calendar.get(Calendar.MILLISECOND), "sss".length());
236:     }
237: 
238:     int offset = tz.getOffset(calendar.getTimeInMillis());
239:     if (offset != 0) {
240:       int hours = Math.abs((offset / (60 * 1000)) / 60);
241:       int minutes = Math.abs((offset / (60 * 1000)) % 60);
242:       formatted.append(offset < 0 ? '-' : '+');
243:       padIsoInt(formatted, hours, "hh".length());
244:       formatted.append(':');
245:       padIsoInt(formatted, minutes, "mm".length());
246:     } else {
247:       formatted.append('Z');
248:     }
249:     return formatted.toString();
250:   }

356:   int parseIsoInt(String value, int beginIndex, int endIndex) {
357:     if (beginIndex < 0 || endIndex > value.length() || beginIndex > endIndex) {
358:       throw new NumberFormatException(value);
359:     }
360:     int i = beginIndex;
361:     int result = 0;
362:     int digit;
363:     if (i < endIndex) {
364:       digit = Character.digit(value.charAt(i++), isoRadix);
365:       if (digit < 0) {
366:         throw new NumberFormatException("Invalid number: " + value.substring(beginIndex, endIndex));
367:       }
368:       result = -digit;
369:     }
370:     while (i < endIndex) {
371:       digit = Character.digit(value.charAt(i++), isoRadix);
372:       if (digit < 0) {
373:         throw new NumberFormatException("Invalid number: " + value.substring(beginIndex, endIndex));
374:       }
375:       result *= isoRadix;
376:       result -= digit;
377:     }
378:     return -result;
379:   }

391:   TimeZone resolveIsoTimeZone(String date, int offset) {
392:     if (date.length() <= offset) {
393:       throw new IllegalArgumentException("No time zone indicator");
394:     }
395:     char timezoneIndicator = date.charAt(offset);
396:     if (timezoneIndicator == 'Z') {
397:       return isoTimeZone;
398:     }
399:     if (timezoneIndicator == '+' || timezoneIndicator == '-') {
400:       String timezoneOffset = date.substring(offset);
401:       timezoneOffset = timezoneOffset.length() >= 5 ? timezoneOffset : timezoneOffset + "00";
402:       if ("+0000".equals(timezoneOffset) || "+00:00".equals(timezoneOffset)) {
403:         return isoTimeZone;
404:       }
405:       String timezoneId = "GMT" + timezoneOffset;
406:       TimeZone timezone = TimeZone.getTimeZone(timezoneId);
407:       String act = timezone.getID();
408:       if (!act.equals(timezoneId)) {
409:         String cleaned = act.replace(":", "");
410:         if (!cleaned.equals(timezoneId)) {
411:           throw new IndexOutOfBoundsException("Mismatching time zone indicator: " + timezoneId
412:               + " given, resolves to " + timezone.getID());
413:         }
414:       }
415:       return timezone;
416:     }

Fixed the NPE in `DefaultDateTypeAdapter` (gson/src/main/java/com/google/gson/DefaultDateTypeAdapter.java:117) with two changes:

- **`write`**: returns `out.nullValue()` for a null `Date` instead of calling `SimpleDateFormat.format(null)` — this is the exact NPE from the issue report.
- **`read`**: handles the JSON null token by returning null, replacing the blanket "must be a string" check; non-null unexpected tokens now fail with `IllegalStateException` from `nextString()`, matching the test expectations.

Verified:
- `mvn -pl gson test` — `testNullValue` and `testUnexpectedToken` now pass; full suite shows zero regressions (all other failures are pre-existing JDK/CLDR locale-formatting issues, identical on the unpatched baseline).
- End-to-end reproduction of the issue scenario: `new GsonBuilder().setDateFormat("yyyy-MM-dd").create().toJson(personWithNullDate)` now emits `{}` without throwing, and date round-tripping still works.
